description: Read and write repositories, issues, pull requests, comments, labels, releases, workflow runs and notifications on github.com in your current tab. Uses your own logged-in GitHub web session.

tools.name: list_repos
tools.description: List repositories for the authenticated user or a specified user/organization. Returns repos sorted by last updated.

tools.name: get_repo
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific repository.

tools.name: create_repo
tools.description: Create a new repository for the authenticated user.

tools.name: list_commits
tools.description: List commits for a repository. Optionally filter by branch or tag. Returns commits sorted by date descending.

tools.name: compare_commits
tools.description: Compare two commits, branches, or tags. Returns the diff status, commit count, and changed files between the base and head.

tools.name: list_releases
tools.description: List releases for a repository. Returns published and draft releases sorted by creation date.

tools.name: create_release
tools.description: Create a new release for a repository. Optionally create as a draft or prerelease.

tools.name: list_issues
tools.description: List issues for a repository. By default returns open issues sorted by creation date. Can filter by state, labels, assignee, and more.

tools.name: get_issue
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific issue, including its full body.

tools.name: create_issue
tools.description: Create a new issue in a repository.

tools.name: update_issue
tools.description: Update an existing issue — change title, body, state, labels, or assignees.

tools.name: search_issues
tools.description: Search issues and pull requests across GitHub. Uses GitHub search syntax — e.g., "repo:owner/name is:open label:bug".

tools.name: list_labels
tools.description: List all labels for a repository. Returns label names, colors, and descriptions.

tools.name: create_label
tools.description: Create a new label in a repository.

tools.name: list_pull_requests
tools.description: List pull requests for a repository with optional state and sort filters.

tools.name: get_pull_request
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific pull request, including merge status and diff stats.

tools.name: create_pull_request
tools.description: Create a new pull request.

tools.name: update_pull_request
tools.description: Update an existing pull request title or body, or close/reopen it.

tools.name: merge_pull_request
tools.description: Merge a pull request. Supports merge commit, squash, and rebase strategies.

tools.name: get_pull_request_diff
tools.description: Get the raw diff of a pull request. Returns the unified diff text for all changed files.

tools.name: list_pull_request_files
tools.description: List files changed in a pull request. Returns filenames, change status, and line-level diff statistics.

tools.name: request_pull_request_review
tools.description: Request reviewers for a pull request. Specify individual users and/or team slugs to request reviews from.

tools.name: list_comments
tools.description: List comments on an issue or pull request.

tools.name: create_comment
tools.description: Add a comment to an issue or pull request.

tools.name: get_user_profile
tools.description: Get a GitHub user's profile. Defaults to the authenticated user if no username is provided.

tools.name: list_org_members
tools.description: List members of a GitHub organization.

tools.name: list_branches
tools.description: List branches for a repository.

tools.name: get_file_content
tools.description: Read a file from a repository. Returns the raw content as text. Use the ref parameter to read from a specific branch or commit.

tools.name: create_or_update_file
tools.description: Create or update a file in a repository. Commits directly to the specified branch.

tools.name: delete_file
tools.description: Delete a file from a repository. Commits directly to the specified branch.

tools.name: list_workflow_runs
tools.description: List workflow runs for a repository. Returns recent workflow runs from the Actions page.

tools.name: get_workflow_run
tools.description: Get information about a specific GitHub Actions workflow run by its run ID.

tools.name: search_repos
tools.description: Search for repositories across GitHub. Supports GitHub search syntax (e.g., "repo:owner/name", "language:typescript", "stars:>1000").

tools.name: add_reaction
tools.description: Add a reaction to an issue, pull request, or comment. Requires the node ID of the subject (e.g., from get_issue or get_pull_request).

tools.name: list_notifications
tools.description: List notifications for the authenticated user. Includes issue, PR, and release notifications.
